namespace Lib;
public class Api
{
    internal Api(int seed) { Seed = seed; }
    public Api() { }
    internal int Seed { get; }
    public int Count { get; internal set; }
    public string Name { get; private protected set; } = "";

    internal const int Max = 5;
    internal static readonly string Ro = "x";

    [return: NotNull]
    internal string? Multi { get { return Name; } set { Name = value ?? ""; } }

    internal class InNested { public void Y() { } }
    public void Run() => Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
}
